title: The Battle for Azovstal: A Soldier’s Story

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 Dealbook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.zh: 时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: For the past two months, a group of Ukrainian fighters has been holed up in a steel plant
sentences.zh: 在过去的两个月里，一群乌克兰战士一直躲在一家钢铁厂里，

sentences.en: in the strategic city of Mariupol, the last stand against Russian forces in a critical part of
sentences.zh: 位于战略要地马里乌波尔，这是乌克兰东部关键地区对抗俄罗斯军队的最后一道防线。

sentences.en: Ukraine's eaSt. On Monday, Ukraine surrendered, leaving the soldiers' fate uncertain.
sentences.zh: 周一，乌克兰投降了，这些士兵的命运变得扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Michael Schwartz, on the story of one of those soldiers and on how a rare
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事迈克尔·施瓦茨将讲述其中一名士兵的故事，以及一场罕见的

sentences.en: Russian victory has already become a rallying cry for resistance in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯胜利是如何成为乌克兰抵抗运动的集结号的。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 今天是周三，

sentences.en: May 18th.
So, Mike, where does this story begin for you?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，这个故事对你来说是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: I'd been in Ukraine covering this war for about three months.
sentences.zh: 我在乌克兰报道这场战争已经大约三个月了。

sentences.en: And at the beginning of the fighting, it became clear that one of the areas that Russia was most interested in was Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 在战斗开始时，很明显俄罗斯最感兴趣的地区之一就是马里乌波尔。

sentences.en: This is a seaside port city that is incredibly important for Russia strategically.
sentences.zh: 这是一个海滨港口城市，对俄罗斯的战略意义极其重大。

sentences.en: It is the window through which
sentences.zh: 它是俄罗斯连接俄罗斯本土与克里米亚半岛的窗口，

sentences.en: Russia can connect Russian territory to the Crimean Peninsula, this patch of land sticking off the end of Ukraine that Russia annexed in 2014.
sentences.zh: 克里米亚半岛是乌克兰末端延伸出来的一块土地，俄罗斯在2014年将其吞并。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, the Russians have been pretty successful in Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，俄罗斯人在马里乌波尔相当成功。

sentences.en: I mean, we've talked before on the show about, you know, them taking over larger and larger parts of the city and that it was, in fact, pretty much just leveled.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们之前在节目中谈到过，你知道，他们接管了城市越来越大的部分，而且实际上，这座城市几乎被夷为平地了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess it depends on how you define success.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想这取决于你如何定义成功。

sentences.en: Militarily, yes, they've been able to seize control of the city, but that's come the cost of the destruction of perhaps 90% of the buildings.
sentences.zh: 从军事上讲，是的，他们已经能够控制这座城市，但这付出了摧毁大约90%建筑的代价。

sentences.en: And as they moved through the city, decimating it, people were pushed to the sea.
sentences.zh: 当他们穿过这座城市并将其摧毁时，人们被逼向了大海。

sentences.en: And the place that they sought refuge primarily was this steel plant, the Azostal steel plant, which became this last bastion of resistance for Ukrainian fighters.
sentences.zh: 他们寻求避难的主要地方就是这家钢铁厂，亚速钢铁厂，它成为了乌克兰战士最后的抵抗堡垒。

sentences.en: And so about a month ago, I started to try and piece together as much as I could about what life was like inside this plant.
sentences.zh: 所以大约一个月前，我开始尝试尽可能多地拼凑出工厂里的生活是什么样的。

sentences.en: You know, how on earth were these people living and keeping the entire might of the Russian military, which had completely taken over this city at bay?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些人到底是如何生活并抵御住俄罗斯军队的全部力量的？毕竟俄军已经完全占领了这座城市。

sentences.en: It's kind of like the Ukrainian Alamo.
sentences.zh: 这有点像乌克兰的阿拉莫战役。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It just seemed to me to be an extraordinary story and an interesting window through which to view the broader war.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这不仅是一个非凡的故事，也是观察这场更广泛战争的一个有趣的窗口。

sentences.en: So, Mike, tell me about this plant.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，跟我说说这个工厂吧。

sentences.en: It's helpful to imagine it more like it's a city within a city.
sentences.zh: 把它想象成一座城中之城会更有帮助。

sentences.en: It's a massive territory about four square miles with multiple buildings.
sentences.zh: 这是一个占地约四平方英里的巨大区域，拥有多栋建筑。

sentences.en: When you look at it from the outside, it looks like a city from some kind of dystopian future.
sentences.zh: 当你从外面看它时，它看起来就像某种反乌托邦未来的城市。

sentences.en: There's massive smokestacks, twisted metal and moving parts and railways running through it all.
sentences.zh: 有巨大的烟囱、扭曲的金属、移动的部件和贯穿其中的铁路。

sentences.en: No trees or sort of natural life to speak of.
sentences.zh: 没有树木，也没有什么自然生命可言。

sentences.en: And when you get inside of it, it was built to be a self-contained place where workers had everything they needed.
sentences.zh: 当你进入内部时，它被建成一个自给自足的地方，工人们拥有他们需要的一切。

sentences.en: There are places to sleep, there are places to eat.
sentences.zh: 有睡觉的地方，有吃饭的地方。

sentences.en: And there are, and this is important in the context of the Cold War when this plant was largely built, there are these nuclear capable bunkers.
sentences.zh: 而且，在冷战背景下（该工厂主要是在那时建造的），这里还有核掩体。

sentences.en: And so there are soldiers down there, but there are also all of these civilians, steel factory workers primarily, who have brought their
sentences.zh: 所以下面有士兵，但也有所有这些平民，主要是钢铁厂工人，他们带着他们的

sentences.en: families and their friends to seek refuge in the place that they think is the safeSt. But they're all spread out all throughout this complex.
sentences.zh: 家人和朋友来寻求避难，因为他们认为这是最安全的地方。但他们分散在整个综合设施中。

sentences.en: There are, you know, 40 people maybe in one bunker and 50 people, you know, miles away in another bunker.
sentences.zh: 你知道，可能一个掩体里有40人，而几英里外的另一个掩体里有50人。

sentences.en: So they may not even see one another.
sentences.zh: 所以他们甚至可能见不到彼此。

sentences.en: And Mike, do we know how many people approximately were down there at any given time?
sentences.zh: 迈克，我们知道在任何特定时间大约有多少人躲在下面吗？

sentences.en: It's not entirely clear.
sentences.zh: 目前还不完全清楚。

sentences.en: I've heard different estimates, you know, in the thousands, including soldiers and civilians.
sentences.zh: 我听到过不同的估计，你知道，有数千人，包括士兵和平民。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Mike, who are these soldiers inside?
sentences.zh: 那么迈克，里面的这些士兵是谁？

sentences.en: There's a real hodgepodge in there.
sentences.zh: 里面的人员构成非常混杂。

sentences.en: You have regular patrol police, you have marines, infantry, and you have the National Guard.
sentences.zh: 有正规巡逻警察、海军陆战队、步兵，还有国民警卫队。

sentences.en: And within the National Guard, you have this group of fighters called the Azov Battalion.
sentences.zh: 而在国民警卫队内部，有一群被称为“亚速营”的战士。

sentences.en: And they have come to really dominate the fighting in there.
sentences.zh: 他们已经真正主导了那里的战斗。

sentences.en: They're probably the largest group of fighters in there.
sentences.zh: 他们可能是里面最大的战士群体。

sentences.en: And this group has a very complicated history.
sentences.zh: 这个组织有着非常复杂的历史。

sentences.en: Going back to 2014, when Russia annexed the Crimean Peninsula and instigated a separatist war in
sentences.zh: 追溯到2014年，当时俄罗斯吞并了克里米亚半岛，并在

sentences.en: eastern Ukraine, that in many ways was the introduction to this war that the Russian forces are fighting now in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰东部煽动了一场分裂战争，这在许多方面都是俄罗斯军队现在在乌克兰进行的这场战争的序幕。

sentences.en: And this Azov Battalion arose at this time, kind of as a volunteer group of guys who were upset and angry about what Russia was doing in the east of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 而这个亚速营就是在那个时候兴起的，当时是一群对俄罗斯在乌克兰东部的所作所为感到不满和愤怒的志愿者。

sentences.en: They were not permitted to enter the army for various reasons.
sentences.zh: 由于各种原因，他们不被允许加入正规军。

sentences.en: The founder of the Azov Battalion was a convicted criminal who got out of jail and founded this group basically as a battalion of misfits.
sentences.zh: 亚速营的创始人是一名有前科的罪犯，他出狱后创立了这个组织，基本上就是一个乌合之众的营队。

sentences.en: Anybody who wanted to could join.
sentences.zh: 任何想加入的人都可以加入。

sentences.en: And if you held unsavory political views, you could join.
sentences.zh: 如果你持有令人反感的政治观点，你也可以加入。

sentences.en: And very quickly, the Azov Battalion became associated with a band of far-right nationalists bordering on fascists.
sentences.zh: 很快，亚速营就与一群接近法西斯主义的极右翼民族主义者联系在了一起。

sentences.en: And it has had trouble shaking this reputation, even as the group has evolved and become more of a regular part of the Ukrainian military and the Ukrainian National Guard.
sentences.zh: 尽管该组织已经演变并成为乌克兰军队和乌克兰国民警卫队的正规组成部分，但它一直难以摆脱这种名声。

sentences.en: And this reputation is important because the fact that perhaps a small contingent of people fighting
sentences.zh: 这种名声很重要，因为在这个营中战斗的可能只是一小部分人

sentences.en: in this battalion held these unsavory views has been used by Putin and the Kremlin to paint the entire
sentences.zh: 持有这些令人反感的观点，但这却被普京和克里姆林宫利用，将整个

sentences.en: Ukrainian nation, the entire Ukrainian government, as a fascist neo-Nazi operation that needs to be cleansed, that needs to be defeated, that needs to be run out of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰国家、整个乌克兰政府描绘成一个需要被清洗、需要被击败、需要被赶出乌克兰的法西斯新纳粹政权。

sentences.en: And the nugget of truth in the Kremlin's narrative for this war is this association that the Azov Battalion had in its infancy.
sentences.zh: 而克里姆林宫这场战争叙事中的真实成分，就是亚速营在成立之初的这种关联。

sentences.en: Mike, are these fighters from the Azov Battalion still these far-right guys?
sentences.zh: 迈克，亚速营的这些战士现在还是那些极右翼分子吗？

sentences.en: I mean, what's the current situation?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，目前的情况如何？

sentences.en: The Azov Battalion is part of the regular Ukrainian military.
sentences.zh: 亚速营是乌克兰正规军的一部分。

sentences.en: It has to adhere to the rules of the chain of command.
sentences.zh: 它必须遵守指挥链的规则。

sentences.en: And the individuals fighting in the plant at this time, some of them have been with the Azov Battalion for years.
sentences.zh: 而在此时在工厂里战斗的人员中，有些人已经在亚速营待了很多年。

sentences.en: Others are new soldiers who were living civilian lives on February 24th, went and volunteered to join the military when the Russians invade and were
sentences.zh: 其他人则是新兵，他们在2月24日还是平民，在俄罗斯入侵时自愿参军，并被

sentences.en: assigned to the Azov Battalion to fight.
sentences.zh: 分配到亚速营作战。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Mike, you've described this plant, which is basically kind of a little island of
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，你描述了这个工厂，它基本上是一个小岛，

sentences.en: Ukrainians that are still fighting and still surviving.
sentences.zh: 上面的乌克兰人仍在战斗，仍在生存。

sentences.en: But how do you go about reporting on it?
sentences.zh: 但你是如何报道它的呢？

sentences.en: I mean, you obviously can't go there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你显然无法去那里。

sentences.en: So what do you do?
sentences.zh: 那你怎么做？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was the biggest challenge in reporting on just the siege of Mariupol in general is that we could not get there.
sentences.zh: 报道马里乌波尔围城战最大的挑战就是我们无法到达那里。

sentences.en: It was so quickly taken over by the Russians.
sentences.zh: 它很快就被俄罗斯人占领了。

sentences.en: And so I started calling around to military sources that I have asking for contacts of people who may be fighting in the steel plant.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始联系我认识的军事消息来源，询问可能在钢铁厂战斗的人员的联系方式。

sentences.en: And eventually, I was able to connect with a young soldier named Leonid Kuznetsov.
sentences.zh: 最终，我联系上了一名年轻的士兵，名叫列昂尼德·库兹涅佐夫。

sentences.en: So, Mike, tell me about Leonid.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，跟我说说列昂尼德吧。

sentences.en: Who is he and what's his story?
sentences.zh: 他是谁，他的故事是什么？

sentences.en: He's 25 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年25岁。

sentences.en: He's a member of the National Guard that is not with the Azov Battalion.
sentences.zh: 他是国民警卫队的一员，不属于亚速营。

sentences.en: And he had been posted to various places around the city in the early weeks of the war, but eventually found himself at the Azov Stahl plant.
sentences.zh: 战争初期，他被派往城市各处，但最终发现自己身处亚速钢铁厂。

sentences.en: And he's been there ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后他就一直待在那里。

sentences.en: And what did you hear from Leonid about what it was like for him inside the plant?
sentences.zh: 你从列昂尼德那里听到了关于他在工厂里的生活是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: We communicated over text primarily because the internet service was so spotty.
sentences.zh: 我们主要通过短信交流，因为互联网服务非常不稳定。

sentences.en: And the first thing that he messaged me was, hello, I'm alive and healthy so far.
sentences.zh: 他发给我的第一条信息是：你好，我还活着，目前很健康。

sentences.en: The situation is very tough.
sentences.zh: 情况非常艰难。

sentences.en: We're on our last food and water.
sentences.zh: 我们的食物和水已经所剩无几了。

sentences.en: And he described a very grim situation.
sentences.zh: 他描述了一个非常严峻的局面。

sentences.en: He spent most of his time underground in the dark in these bunkers under a relentless and terrifying
sentences.zh: 他大部分时间都待在黑暗的地下掩体里，遭受着俄罗斯人无情且恐怖的

sentences.en: bombing campaign by the Russians that could be heard, that could be seen in many cases as the
sentences.zh: 轰炸，这些轰炸声清晰可闻，在许多情况下，甚至能看到

sentences.en: Russian bombs chipped away at the concrete overhead that was protecting them.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的炸弹一点点凿开了保护他们的头顶混凝土。

sentences.en: He described cave-ins that have crushed people and buried people alive.
sentences.zh: 他描述了导致人员被压死、被活埋的坍塌事故。

sentences.en: And they're witnessing this, you know, helplessly.
sentences.zh: 他们只能无助地目睹这一切。

sentences.en: You know, there's, they don't have, they have weapons, they have some ammunition, they don't have the kind of weapons that they could use to fight against Russian airstrikes,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们没有……他们有武器，有一些弹药，但他们没有那种可以用来对抗俄罗斯空袭、

sentences.en: Russian artillery strikes, attacks from the sea.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯炮击、海上攻击的武器。

sentences.en: Russia has this place surrounded and is just pummeling it into the dirt.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯已经包围了这个地方，正在将其夷为平地。

sentences.en: And in order to find food, in order to find water, in order to fight, they have to leave the safety of these shelters amid this relentless bombing campaign and go out onto the
sentences.zh: 为了寻找食物、寻找水、为了战斗，他们必须在无情的轰炸中离开掩体的安全地带，走到

sentences.en: grounds of the factory and forage, essentially, for their survival before racing back into their shelters.
sentences.zh: 工厂的场地上，基本上是为了生存而搜寻物资，然后再冲回掩体。

sentences.en: You're describing these unbelievably wrenching circumstances this guy is in.
sentences.zh: 你描述的这个家伙所处的环境真是令人心碎。

sentences.en: What does he say about how he's feeling?
sentences.zh: 他怎么说自己的感受？

sentences.en: I mean, what does he think about all of this?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他怎么看待这一切？

sentences.en: When I asked him if he was afraid, he texted back, everyone's afraid from time to time.
sentences.zh: 当我问他是否害怕时，他回复说：每个人偶尔都会害怕。

sentences.en: My feelings are within the bounds of normal.
sentences.zh: 我的感受在正常范围内。

sentences.en: And when I asked him about, you know, what his plan was, what the soldiers with
sentences.zh: 当我问他，你知道，他的计划是什么，和他在一起的士兵，

sentences.en: him, what they wanted to do to get out, he told me, quite frankly, he said, you know, we're hoping for help.
sentences.zh: 他们想怎么逃出去时，他坦率地告诉我，他说：你知道，我们在等待救援。

sentences.en: He says, without it, we will not be able to leave the factory.
sentences.zh: 他说，没有救援，我们将无法离开工厂。

sentences.en: We will die here with our weapons in our hands defending Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我们将死在这里，手持武器保卫乌克兰。

sentences.en: There are no other options.
sentences.zh: 没有其他选择。

sentences.en: And after that text, the messages
sentences.zh: 在那条短信之后，信息

sentences.en: essentially stop.
sentences.zh: 基本上就停止了。

sentences.en: But in one of our exchanges, I asked whether there was anybody on the outside of
sentences.zh: 但在我们的一次交流中，我问过工厂外面是否还有人，

sentences.en: the plant, anybody, any of his family or friends that I could talk to, to find out more about what he might be going through and more about his life.
sentences.zh: 是否有他的家人或朋友我可以交谈，以了解更多关于他可能正在经历的事情以及他的生活。

sentences.en: And he immediately suggested that I reach out to his wife, Maria.
sentences.zh: 他立即建议我联系他的妻子玛丽亚。

sentences.en: What was it like talking to her?
sentences.zh: 和她交谈是什么感觉？

sentences.en: She answers with this achingly sad voice.
sentences.zh: 她用一种令人心碎的悲伤声音回答。

sentences.en: And I asked her how she's doing.
sentences.zh: 我问她最近怎么样。

sentences.en: She responds, it's hard to answer right now.
sentences.zh: 她回答说：现在很难回答。

sentences.en: And she asked me, do you know about my husband?
sentences.zh: 她问我：你知道我丈夫的消息吗？

sentences.en: He's in Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 他在马里乌波尔。

sentences.en: And I asked whether she'd heard from him today, that day that I called.
sentences.zh: 我问她那天我打电话时是否收到过他的消息。

sentences.en: She said, no, nothing.
sentences.zh: 她说：没有，什么都没有。

sentences.en: And then she proceeds to tell me their story.
sentences.zh: 然后她开始讲述他们的故事。

sentences.en: She starts off by saying that they met in college.
sentences.zh: 她从他们是在大学相识开始说起。

sentences.en: He's two years older.
sentences.zh: 他比她大两岁。

sentences.en: They both grew up in Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 他们都在马里乌波尔长大。

sentences.en: And they went to the same university.
sentences.zh: 他们上了同一所大学。

sentences.en: She was studying to become a fitness instructor.
sentences.zh: 她当时正在学习成为一名健身教练。

sentences.en: And Leonid was studying physical therapy.
sentences.zh: 列昂尼德当时在学习物理治疗。

sentences.en: But their first meeting didn't actually take place until they both happened to be attending a comedy show where a very famous comedian
sentences.zh: 但他们的第一次见面实际上是在他们都碰巧参加一场喜剧表演时发生的，当时一位非常有名的喜剧演员

sentences.en: by the name of Volodymyr Zelensky was performing in Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 名叫弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基正在马里乌波尔表演。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: This is now the president of the country.
sentences.zh: 这现在是这个国家的总统。

sentences.en: And as Maria put it, the two of them like to joke that the president of Ukraine is responsible for their getting together.
sentences.zh: 正如玛丽亚所说，他们俩喜欢开玩笑说，乌克兰总统要为他们的结合负责。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So then what happened after they met and started spending time together?
sentences.zh: 那他们相遇并开始相处之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: She says that she fell for him.
sentences.zh: 她说她爱上了他。

sentences.en: She said that, you know, as they started spending time together, she came to realize that, in her words,
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，随着他们开始相处，她逐渐意识到，用她的话说，

sentences.en: this is my person.
sentences.zh: 这就是我要找的人。

sentences.en: And they fell in love.
sentences.zh: 他们坠入了爱河。

sentences.en: They got married.
sentences.zh: 他们结婚了。

sentences.en: And they started a life together.
sentences.zh: 他们开始共同生活。

sentences.en: They graduated college.
sentences.zh: 他们大学毕业了。

sentences.en: Leonid joined the military right after he graduated.
sentences.zh: 列昂尼德毕业后立即参了军。

sentences.en: David, right?
sentences.zh: 大卫，对吧？

sentences.en: They had a baby named David.
sentences.zh: 他们生了个孩子，叫大卫。

sentences.en: And they started to take the next steps in planning out their lives.
sentences.zh: 他们开始规划人生的下一步。

sentences.en: After three years in the military,
sentences.zh: 在军队待了三年后，

sentences.en: Leonid decided it was time to move on.
sentences.zh: 列昂尼德觉得是时候继续前进了。

sentences.en: And so he started preparing paperwork for a career in law enforcement
sentences.zh: 于是他开始准备文书工作，打算从事执法工作，

sentences.en: and retired from the military in December 2021.
sentences.zh: 并于2021年12月从军队退役。

sentences.en: In other words, two months before the war.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，是在战争爆发前两个月。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what you have to remember that two months before the start of the war, it was inconceivable for Ukrainians that Russia could launch a major invasion,
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，在战争爆发前两个月，乌克兰人根本无法想象俄罗斯会发动大规模入侵，

sentences.en: even though officials in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 尽管美国官员

sentences.en: and elsewhere had started talking about this possibility.
sentences.zh: 和其他地方的人已经开始谈论这种可能性。

sentences.en: And so he went back to his old National Guard unit, not the Azov Battalion, and signed up to fight for his country.
sentences.zh: 于是他回到了原来的国民警卫队部队，而不是亚速营，并报名参战保卫国家。

sentences.en: And what did Maria think about that?
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚对此怎么看？

sentences.en: She was opposed.
sentences.zh: 她反对。

sentences.en: And she said that she tried to convince him not to do it.
sentences.zh: 她说她试图说服他不要去。

sentences.en: She pleaded with him, even.
sentences.zh: 她甚至恳求过他。

sentences.en: And for a time, he relented and allowed her to say her piece and to try and convince him.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他心软了，让她表达了自己的想法，试图说服他。

sentences.en: But then one day, he put his foot down and made a decision.
sentences.zh: 但有一天，他态度坚决，做出了决定。

sentences.en: He gathered his things and left the house and went off to fight the war.
sentences.zh: 他收拾好行李，离开了家，去参加战争了。

sentences.en: You know, Maria told me this story that I think really reveals starkly what Russia's intentions are for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，玛丽亚告诉我的这个故事，我认为非常鲜明地揭示了俄罗斯对乌克兰的意图。

sentences.en: She herself lived through the first month or so of the war in Mariupol and then was able to escape.
sentences.zh: 她自己经历了马里乌波尔战争的第一个月左右，然后设法逃了出来。

sentences.en: And she talks about getting to a Russian checkpoint and seeing a Russian soldier there.
sentences.zh: 她谈到到达一个俄罗斯检查站，看到那里有一个俄罗斯士兵。

sentences.en: And she recalled asking him
sentences.zh: 她回忆说她问他

sentences.en: which direction Ukraine was in because she wanted to resettle in Ukrainian-controlled territory.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰在哪个方向，因为她想在乌克兰控制的领土上重新定居。

sentences.en: And this soldier took one look at her and her child and said,
sentences.zh: 这个士兵看了她和她的孩子一眼，说，

sentences.en: we will exterminate everyone there.
sentences.zh: 我们会消灭那里所有人。

sentences.en: Go to Russia.
sentences.zh: 去俄罗斯吧。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的收藏品去工作，把DJ台变成一个

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你

sentences.en: The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载

sentences.en: The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Mike, now that Leonid is in the steel plant and seeing how dire things are around him, has he ever voiced any regret that he reenlisted?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，现在列昂尼德身处钢铁厂，看到周围的情况如此严峻，他有没有后悔过重新入伍？

sentences.en: Maria says that he never once voiced any regret.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚说他从未表达过任何后悔。

sentences.en: He went there to protect his family and his country and that's what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 他去那里是为了保护他的家人和国家，这就是他正在做的事情。

sentences.en: He told her that she needs to be prepared for any outcome by which he meant that she needs to prepare herself for the possibility that he won't return.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，她需要为任何结果做好准备，意思是她需要为他可能回不来的可能性做好心理准备。

sentences.en: But he also told her that the one thing that he didn't expect, the one thing he wasn't prepared for, was a feeling that he had been abandoned, he and his fellow soldiers.
sentences.zh: 但他也告诉她，他唯一没料到、唯一没准备好的，就是感到自己被抛弃了，他和他的战友们。

sentences.en: He feels that they have been left simply to the mercy of the Russians, that the Ukrainian government hasn't done enough to save them.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他们被彻底留在了俄罗斯人的手中，任人宰割，乌克兰政府没有采取足够的措施来拯救他们。

sentences.en: But wait, Mike, is that true?
sentences.zh: 等等，迈克，这是真的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, did Ukraine's government
sentences.zh: 我是说，乌克兰政府

sentences.en: abandon them?
sentences.zh: 抛弃了他们吗？

sentences.en: And the reality is they're stuck in there.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是他们被困在里面了。

sentences.en: The planet's fully surrounded by Russian forces.
sentences.zh: 整个工厂被俄罗斯军队完全包围了。

sentences.en: Russian forces control the city.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯军队控制着这座城市。

sentences.en: Russian forces control miles and miles of territory outside of Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯军队控制着马里乌波尔外围数英里的领土。

sentences.en: To fight their way out is impossible.
sentences.zh: 想要杀出重围是不可能的。

sentences.en: And so, in order for the Ukrainian government militarily to try and rescue these soldiers, it would require a colossal amount of troops and forces
sentences.zh: 因此，乌克兰政府若想在军事上营救这些士兵，需要投入大量的部队和力量

sentences.en: to plunge into now Russian-controlled territory, fight their way into this plant and get them out.
sentences.zh: 深入现在由俄罗斯控制的领土，杀进工厂把他们救出来。

sentences.en: It's just militarily unrealistic at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前在军事上是不现实的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But far from the battle lines, there appeared to be some pretty concerted negotiations underway with Russia to evacuate people from the plant.
sentences.zh: 但在远离战线的地方，似乎正在与俄罗斯进行一些相当协调的谈判，以撤离工厂里的人员。

sentences.en: And at the beginning of May, we learn that Ukraine and Russia have negotiated a ceasefire that is going to allow the civilians that are still trapped inside this plant to get out.
sentences.zh: 五月初，我们得知乌克兰和俄罗斯谈判达成了一项停火协议，允许仍被困在工厂内的平民撤离。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Around this time, I get a voice message from Leonid.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，我收到了列昂尼德的一条语音信息。

sentences.en: This is the first time that I've actually heard his voice.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次真正听到他的声音。

sentences.en: And he sounds, you know, just exhausted, but, you know, very pointed and matter of fact.
sentences.zh: 他听起来，你知道，精疲力竭，但非常明确且实事求是。

sentences.en: He says, last week, we did not go outside and delight at all.
sentences.zh: 他说，上周，我们根本没有出去过，也没有任何喜悦。

sentences.en: And that there's been constant, massive shelling.
sentences.zh: 而且一直有持续不断的猛烈炮击。

sentences.en: He says, we were dealing with the search for food ourselves and the search for water because water is that source that no one just gives you.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们不得不自己寻找食物和水，因为水是那种没人会直接给你的资源。

sentences.en: After I hear from him, the situation only becomes more dire.
sentences.zh: 在我听到他的消息后，情况变得更加严峻。

sentences.en: The field hospital that soldiers have been using at one point collapsed underneath the bombing campaign and a number of people are crushed underneath it and that renders
sentences.zh: 士兵们一直在使用的野战医院在一次轰炸中倒塌，许多人被压在下面，这使得

sentences.en: it unusable.
sentences.zh: 它无法使用。

sentences.en: And the wounded don't even have rudimentary medicine, they don't have bandages, there's no anesthesia to conduct surgeries and people are just dying from wounds that normally
sentences.zh: 伤员甚至没有基本的药物，没有绷带，没有麻醉剂来做手术，人们只是死于通常

sentences.en: would be easily treatable.
sentences.zh: 很容易治疗的伤口。

sentences.en: Oof.
sentences.zh: 哎呀。

sentences.en: And what's more,
sentences.zh: 而且更糟糕的是，

sentences.en: Russian forces were able to break into the territory of the plant.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯军队得以突破进入了工厂区域。

sentences.en: So you're starting to have intense fighting, not only from the air and from the sea and from the artillery bombardment, we were actually having soldiers enter into the territory
sentences.zh: 所以你开始面临激烈的战斗，不仅来自空中、海上和炮火轰炸，实际上还有士兵进入了

sentences.en: of the plant that these Ukrainian defenders have to fight againSt.
sentences.zh: 这些乌克兰守军必须对抗的工厂区域。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And so this refuge for these soldiers becomes smaller and smaller and this goes on for several weeks until Monday.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些士兵的避难所变得越来越小，这种情况持续了几个星期，直到周一。

sentences.en: And what happened on Monday?
sentences.zh: 周一发生了什么？

sentences.en: We start hearing what to me is kind of unbelievable news that somehow the Ukrainian government had been able to negotiate with the Russians and reached an agreement to evacuate
sentences.zh: 我们开始听到对我来说简直难以置信的消息，乌克兰政府不知何故能够与俄罗斯人谈判并达成协议，撤离

sentences.en: at least some of the soldiers who were at this steel plant starting with the most severely wounded.
sentences.zh: 至少部分在钢铁厂的士兵，首先是伤势最严重的那些。

sentences.en: And that evening
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，

sentences.en: Zelensky releases a video confirming that an operation is underway to, in his words, save the lives of our guys.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基发布了一段视频，证实正在进行一项行动，用他的话说，是为了拯救我们小伙子们的生命。

sentences.en: He says, I want to emphasize
sentences.zh: 他说，我想强调，

sentences.en: Ukraine needs
sentences.zh: 乌克兰需要

sentences.en: Ukrainian heroes alive.
sentences.zh: 活着的乌克兰英雄。

sentences.en: As of now, we're told about 260 soldiers were evacuated from the plant and this includes
sentences.zh: 截至目前，我们被告知约有260名士兵从工厂撤离，其中包括

sentences.en: 53 of the soldiers who are most critically wounded.
sentences.zh: 53名伤势最严重的士兵。

sentences.en: And we were able to see video of this evacuation in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们能够看到这次撤离的视频。

sentences.en: You saw
sentences.zh: 你看到

sentences.en: Russian soldiers conducting pat-downs of some of these
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯士兵对其中一些

sentences.en: Ukrainians who had come out, checking them presumably for weapons.
sentences.zh: 走出来的乌克兰人进行搜身，大概是在检查他们是否携带武器。

sentences.en: Others are brought out on stretchers, some with what appear to be particularly grievous injuries.
sentences.zh: 其他人被用担架抬出来，有些人看起来伤势特别严重。

sentences.en: You see military medics attending to them, wrapping wounds in gauze.
sentences.zh: 你看到军医在照顾他们，用纱布包扎伤口。

sentences.en: And then you're seeing them loaded onto these buses where some soldiers are seated in seats, others are on these stretchers.
sentences.zh: 然后你看到他们被装上这些巴士，一些士兵坐在座位上，其他人躺在担架上。

sentences.en: And they're taken away, we're told, to hospitals in what is now Russian controlled territory.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，他们被带到了现在由俄罗斯控制领土上的医院。

sentences.en: And what we're told by Ukrainian officials is that eventually these individuals will be traded for Russian prisoners of war held by Ukraine and that these 260 will eventually
sentences.zh: 乌克兰官员告诉我们，最终这些人将与乌克兰扣押的俄罗斯战俘进行交换，这260人最终

sentences.en: make it back to Ukrainian held territory.
sentences.zh: 会回到乌克兰控制的领土。

sentences.en: What about
sentences.zh: 那

sentences.en: Leonid?
sentences.zh: 列昂尼德呢？

sentences.en: What's his situation?
sentences.zh: 他的情况如何？

sentences.en: Do you know anything about him?
sentences.zh: 你知道关于他的任何消息吗？

sentences.en: We just don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道。

sentences.en: We don't know if he was one of the injured who was able to get out.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他是否是那些能够撤离的伤员之一。

sentences.en: There are still, as far as we understand, hundreds of troops still left in the plant and what their fate is going to be, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，工厂里还有数百名士兵，他们的命运将会如何，我们不知道。

sentences.en: I received a message from Maria, his wife, this morning and she doesn't know anything.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我收到了他妻子玛丽亚的消息，她什么都不知道。

sentences.en: She hasn't heard from him.
sentences.zh: 她没有收到他的任何消息。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that these guys aren't out of the woods yet.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道的是，这些小伙子们还没有脱离险境。

sentences.en: The ones that were able to escape the plant, they're on
sentences.zh: 那些能够逃出工厂的人，他们身处

sentences.en: Russian-controlled territory.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯控制的领土上。

sentences.en: And while the Ukrainian government says that they hope that these guys will be traded for
sentences.zh: 虽然乌克兰政府表示希望这些人能与

sentences.en: Russian POWs brought back to Ukrainian territory, we know that throughout this process
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯战俘交换并带回乌克兰领土，但我们知道在整个过程中，

sentences.en: Russia has continuously negotiated in bad faith.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯一直在进行恶意谈判。

sentences.en: Already we're starting to hear voices inside.
sentences.zh: 我们已经开始听到内部的声音，

sentences.en: Russia call for trials, call for a declaration of the Azov battalion and any of its fighters to be considered terrorists.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯呼吁进行审判，呼吁宣布亚速营及其任何战士为恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And so we just don't know what is going to happen to these guys ultimately.
sentences.zh: 所以我们根本不知道这些小伙子最终会发生什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, it doesn't bode well for Leonid.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这对列昂尼德来说不是好兆头。

sentences.en: Not at the moment.
sentences.zh: 目前还不是。

sentences.en: Mike, what will it look like in the history books?
sentences.zh: 迈克，历史书上会怎么写？
